Envicool.why: Supplies data-center and server liquid cooling (Coolinside cold plates, quick disconnects, manifolds, CDUs) and room cooling; its liquid-cooling products are in large-scale use at compute-chip and compute/switch equipment makers, so AI data-center build-out drives its revenue
Envicool.evidence: 2026 half-year report (08-25-2026): Coolinside quick-change connectors, manifolds, cold plates, long-life coolant and leak detection recognized by mainstream compute-chip makers and leading compute and switch equipment makers and beginning large-scale application

players.product: Coolinside full-chain liquid cooling for AI servers and data centers (cold plates, UQD/MQD quick disconnects, manifolds, CDUs, coolant) plus data-center room and cabinet cooling

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 3,016.71 million, up 17.24% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 184.77 million, down 14.32%. Data-center room cooling products RMB 1,700.14 million (up 25.84%, gross margin 23.34%, down 2.49 points on regional and product mix; domestic sales still dominate and are highly competitive, overseas revenue rose sharply but remains a small share); cabinet cooling products (telecom, energy storage) RMB 1,067.76 million (up 15.28%). Overseas revenue RMB 444.10 million, up 71.39%, 14.72% of revenue, at a 48.20% gross margin.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 3,016.71 million (+17.24%); net profit RMB 184.77 million (-14.32%); room cooling RMB 1,700.14 million (+25.84%); overseas RMB 444.10 million (+71.39%)

quarterly_data.signal: Liquid cooling: Envicool's Coolinside end-to-end liquid-cooling line covers cold plates, quick disconnects, manifolds, CDUs, cabinets, long-life coolant, piping and cold sources, plus pump-driven two-phase cold-plate systems and liquid-cooled compute pods. Its quick-change connectors, manifolds, cold plates, long-life coolant and leak-detection products have been recognized by some mainstream compute-chip makers and leading compute and switch equipment makers and have begun large-scale application. Its cold plates cool CPUs, GPUs, compute ASICs and switch ASICs and now also memory, SSDs and optical modules for 100% liquid cooling; it is developing two-phase and jet cold plates for local ultra-high heat flux.
Customer Google: at the 2025 OCP Global Summit the company exhibited a Deschutes 5 CDU product custom-developed for Google.

Partner NVIDIA: the company states its UQD product was listed as an NVIDIA MGX ecosystem partner at the 2024 OCP Global Summit (alongside NVIDIA's Blackwell GB200 system news), and at the 2025 OCP Global Summit its UQD and MQD products were listed as NVIDIA MGX ecosystem partners.

Partner Intel: Envicool's cold plates were included in the Design Guide of Intel's Eagle Stream servers in 2023; its BHS-AP platform cold plate, UQD04 quick connector, manifold and rack-mounted liquid-cooling CDU passed Intel testing and validation, making it the first cold-plate liquid-cooling solution integrator for the Intel Xeon 6 platform (company claim).
Liquid-cooling connectors: subsidiary Envicool Intelligent Connection (liquid-cooling piping and quick connectors) had H1 2026 revenue of RMB 191.30 million and net profit of RMB 29.13 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 191.30 million; net profit RMB 29.13 million

quarterly_data.signal: Management view: expanding into the overseas liquid-cooling compute market is a key direction; overseas demand is strong and some products are listed in customers' ecosystem partner programs, but the company faces new supply-chain relationships, fast customer-specific iteration and higher quality requirements, so whether the expansion succeeds and reaches volume production is uncertain.
